utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Mara! I just heard Opal is heading to the garage for the repair drive—did I get the location mixed up?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: No, you've got it right, Tess—Opal's heading to the garage. I'm just making sure we've got all the supplies lined up before folks arrive.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh good, I was worried I'd been telling everyone the wrong place! Is there anything I can help you with for supplies?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, Jules, I'm still hoping to make it Saturday—just been crazy busy lately.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No worries, Bo! Just come when you can—every bit helps, and we'll save a spot for you.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Jules. I'll be there if I can get through my to-do list by then.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Kira, what time does the repair drive start? I've got a broken shelf to bring by.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait—are you talking about the repair drive? I'm not the one running it, I think you've got me mixed up with someone else.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh sorry about that! Do you know who's organizing the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hey Leo, did you catch if the repair drive is definitely starting at 9? I'm trying to plan around my school runs.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, still on for 9. Just need help loading the heavy stuff into the truck.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, 9 works. I can help load for a bit before I have to peel off for pickup — is that early enough to get the heavy stuff done?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, Leo! Let me give you a hand with that lawnmower.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh Sam, while you're helping Leo, make sure his house isn't too far from the repair route—we're trying to conserve every drop of gas.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Good point, Pia. I'll check the route and make sure Leo's place is on the way.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive... I think we still need to figure out the date. Did you say anything about supplies, Vik?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yes, it's this weekend! They're fixing small appliances and electronics, like toasters and laptops. Do you know if we need any supplies?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, this weekend? I thought it was next week... Well, I'm not sure about supplies—maybe some extra screwdrivers and soldering kits?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey everyone, sorry I'm late. Did we already figure out who's bringing what for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I'm hoping we'll lock down a date soon, Dane. I like to have everything set well in advance.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it, Eli, I'm with you on that. So has anyone nailed down a date yet, or are we still floating ideas?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Nell, I heard you're in on the repair drive too. I've got plenty of tools if you need to borrow anything.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Wait, this weekend? I thought the repair drive was a couple weekends from now. Are we meeting for something else?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No no, the repair drive's still a ways off, I just wanted to make sure folks know I'm good for lending tools whenever they need 'em.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: So, Noah, what exactly is this repair drive about? I want to make sure I understand the details before we dive in.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the repair drive! It's this weekend, I think? I'm planning to bring a broken toaster, but I'll probably show up late, like around noon.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Noon? I thought it started earlier. Did you see the schedule somewhere?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Quinn, I think we're in good shape on most tools, but we could really use some extra sandpaper if you've got any lying around.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, sandpaper! Let me check my garage—I think I have a few sheets from that shelf I sanded down last month. I'll bring 'em by this afternoon!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, Quinn! Every bit helps—those sheets will come in handy for smoothing out the rough edges on some of the benches we're fixing up.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Opal, you know about the repair drive? Gus said he's got tools if we need 'em.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh, good, Gus is offering tools—but first, let's confirm the repair drive is still in the garage where we left it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, let's check the garage first before we grab any tools.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Dane. That would be great.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Uli, just a heads-up—the repair drive is now on Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Oh, right, Sunday—I'll make sure to bring those tools from my shed.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: What if it rains? We need a backup plan for keeping the tools dry.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Good point! I was thinking we could set up a tarp canopy—I know Gus has a big one—or maybe use the garage on my side if needed.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That's a good start, but I'm still worried about the gas—do we have enough to cover all the stops without running out?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Vik, I heard you're helping with the repair drive too. Need a hand with any of the heavier stuff?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh definitely! We're fixing small appliances and electronics like toasters and laptops. If you can help carry the bigger items, that'd be great!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, I can help with that. Just point me at the heaviest boxes.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Oh, that sounds like a great idea. Is it happening this weekend? I'd like to learn more before I commit.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It's shaping up for next Saturday, but we're still nailing down the exact time. Want to swing by my place later? I can fill you in on all the details.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Sure, I'd love to come by. Should I bring anything, like my toolbox or the manual I mentioned?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Bo, have you heard the latest? I just ran into Opal and she said the repair drive is actually at the garage, not the community center like I thought!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, the garage? Right, I think I remember someone saying that. Guess I mixed up the details.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Well, I'm glad we're figuring it out! At least now I know where to go if I want to lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: It's a community thing where we fix up broken household items together. I'm collecting tools and supplies. You in?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely, I'm in! I've got my wrenches and screws ready to go whenever you need 'em.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks Gus. Can you bring them to my place around 6?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, Opal! The repair drive is now on Sunday at the community center, not Saturday on the front porch. I hope you can still make it!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Wait, I thought it was at the garage! Did we move it without updating the schedule?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh honey, no—it's never been at the garage! We moved it from the front porch to the community center on Sunday to have more space and shelter if it rains.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, let's just meet this weekend to sort through tools. I think I have some old ones in the shed that might help.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Wait, is it this weekend? I thought we had more time. I haven't even found my toaster yet.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Oh, sorry for the confusion. I just meant to meet up to go through tools this weekend, not for the repair drive yet.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Ira! Have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday? We're fixing up the community center—want to join?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, I'm already helping Oren pick up supplies—need me to grab anything else while I'm out?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That's great, Ira! I think we're good on supplies, but thanks for offering. See you Saturday!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, Sam! The repair drive... I think it's happening, but I can't quite remember when. Do you know?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I think it's next Saturday at 10 a.m., but I'm planning to swing by Leo's place to help load that lawnmower if you want to join me.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Next Saturday at 10, you say? That sounds right. I'll meet you at Leo's; I could use the walk to clear my head.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Faye, I'm checking our supply list for the repair drive. Do you know if we have enough nails and screws?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, I think Jules mentioned we might be a bit short on nails. Let me check my list after I pick up the kids from school.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Alright, let me know what you find—I can ask around to see if anyone has extra nails to spare.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait—are you sure I'm the one you're talking to? I really don't recall organizing any repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, the repair drive. Can you help me lift this equipment into the truck?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, Leo—I think you've got the wrong person. I'm not involved in any repair drive.
